subject.title: fix(codex): require explicit final source delivery

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` completion require explicit `final=true`, or preserve implicit terminal delivery and rely on final-only prompt steering?
rationale: Both approaches address the reproduced premature-termination bug, but they establish incompatible durable behavior for otherwise valid completed source sends; source history and tests cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Adopt explicit final intent
options.body: Approve this scoped runtime contract and require completed current-source sends to set `final=true`.

options.title: Keep implicit completion
options.body: Use the prompt-only approach so confirmed current-source sends remain terminal without a new model-facing completion flag.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit final intent
recommendation.body: Approve this scoped runtime contract and require completed current-source sends to set `final=true`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged source-reply completion work established the terminal-recognition contract this decision would change.
